TaskCreated.title: TaskCreated
TaskCreated.description: Emitted when a new Task Shell is created.

TaskStateChanged.title: TaskStateChanged
TaskStateChanged.description: Emitted when a Task Shell changes lifecycle state.

TaskTerminated.title: TaskTerminated
TaskTerminated.description: Final terminal event for a Task Shell with termination reason.

FinalSummaryEmitted.title: FinalSummaryEmitted
FinalSummaryEmitted.description: Emitted when final summary block for a Task Shell is available.

AttemptStarted.title: AttemptStarted
AttemptStarted.description: Emitted when an Attempt within a Task begins.

PhaseCompleted.title: PhaseCompleted
PhaseCompleted.description: Emitted when a Phase completes successfully.

PhaseFailed.title: PhaseFailed
PhaseFailed.description: Emitted when a Phase fails with error details.

ThoughtStarted.title: ThoughtStarted
ThoughtStarted.description: Marks the start of an internal Thought Block (reasoning trace).

ThoughtCompleted.title: ThoughtCompleted
ThoughtCompleted.description: Marks completion of a Thought Block and includes content reference (opaque).

ToolExecutionStarted.title: ToolExecutionStarted
ToolExecutionStarted.description: Emitted when a concrete system command/tool begins execution.

ToolExecutionOutput.title: ToolExecutionOutput
ToolExecutionOutput.description: Streaming stdout/stderr chunk emitted during tool execution.

ToolExecutionCompleted.title: ToolExecutionCompleted
ToolExecutionCompleted.description: Emitted when a tool/command finishes with exit code.

ProgressStepAdded.title: ProgressStepAdded
ProgressStepAdded.description: Add a progress step to a progress list inside a tool execution.

ProgressStepUpdated.title: ProgressStepUpdated
ProgressStepUpdated.description: Updates status/metadata for an existing progress step.

ReviewerResultEmitted.title: ReviewerResultEmitted
ReviewerResultEmitted.description: Captured verdict and issue list from a Reviewer Agent.

RegenerationTriggered.title: RegenerationTriggered
RegenerationTriggered.description: System-authored block explaining why a regeneration attempt is authorized.

AbortTriggered.title: AbortTriggered
AbortTriggered.description: Emitted when a user or system aborts the Task.

MaxAttemptsReached.title: MaxAttemptsReached
MaxAttemptsReached.description: Emitted when the task has exhausted allowed attempts.

SystemFatalError.title: SystemFatalError
SystemFatalError.description: Emitted when an unrecoverable internal error occurs.

ArtifactProduced.title: ArtifactProduced
ArtifactProduced.description: Emitted when a tangible output artifact is produced by a Task.

CollapseStateUpdated.title: CollapseStateUpdated
CollapseStateUpdated.description: UI-only event persisting collapse/expand state per Task Shell.

UserOverrideVisibility.title: UserOverrideVisibility
UserOverrideVisibility.description: Records when a user explicitly toggles visibility for an element.

ResourceUsageSampled.title: ResourceUsageSampled
ResourceUsageSampled.description: Snapshots of resource consumption during execution.

ResourceLimitExceeded.title: ResourceLimitExceeded
ResourceLimitExceeded.description: Alert when a resource limit is breached.

PolicyEvaluated.title: PolicyEvaluated
PolicyEvaluated.description: Record of a policy decision (e.g., retry authorization).

UserActionPerformed.title: UserActionPerformed
UserActionPerformed.description: Explicit user interaction with the Task Shell UI.

AgentBoundToPhase.title: AgentBoundToPhase
AgentBoundToPhase.description: Links a concrete agent configuration to an execution phase.

ArtifactValidated.title: ArtifactValidated
ArtifactValidated.description: Record of an artifact passing a validation check.

ArtifactConsumed.title: ArtifactConsumed
ArtifactConsumed.description: Record of an artifact being used by a component.

ArtifactRejected.title: ArtifactRejected
ArtifactRejected.description: Record of an artifact being explicitly rejected by a component/user.

ReplayVerified.title: ReplayVerified
ReplayVerified.description: Assertion that a task execution stream is deterministic and verified.

PhaseMetricsReported.title: PhaseMetricsReported
PhaseMetricsReported.description: Aggregate performance metrics for a completed phase.
